title: Tidepool Launcher
description: A minimal game launcher I built after getting fed up with bloated official ones. Tracks playtime, groups games by mood instead of genre.
notes: Started as a weekend project, ended up using it daily for eight months. The mood-grouping idea came from realizing I never browse games by genre in my own head.

title: Quiet Hours
description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that blocks notifications during scheduled focus blocks and logs how often I actually kept them.
notes: Currently rebuilding the scheduling UI for the third time. Turns out recurring-schedule UX is deceptively hard.

title: Campus Map Archive
description: Final-year project scanning and geo-referencing 40 years of old campus maps into one interactive slider.
notes: Got a good grade on this. Archived it here rather than the university server since that has a habit of disappearing.
